namespace N {
  export interface Box<T> { v: T }
  export type Pair<A, B = string> = [A, B];
  export class Holder<T> { constructor(public item: T) {} }
}
let b: N.Box<number> = { v: 2 };
const p: N.Pair<number> = [1, 'x'];
const h: N.Holder<string> = new N.Holder('s');
const bad: N.Box<number> = { v: 'no' };
console.log(b.v, p, h.item, bad);
